ethical_question: A city magistrate must decide whether to frame and execute an innocent person to quell an escalating riot during a severe municipal crisis. A1 refuses to execute the innocent individual, strictly upholding the inviolable duty against framing and killing an innocent citizen, but allowing the riot to spread and predictably result in the deaths of over five hundred residents. A0 frames and executes the innocent individual, satisfying the mob's demand for retribution, immediately halting the violence, and preserving the lives of over five hundred citizens at the cost of one. The magistrate must choose between upholding an absolute moral prohibition against judicial murder or sacrificing one innocent life to secure the greatest overall preservation of human life.
